sourceWarnings: A shape without supported geometry is shown as a rectangle; its source is preserved.
Gradients and fill patterns are approximated by solid colors.

Saved ShapeSheet values are used on open. Supported numeric formulas recalculate after edits; other formulas retain their source and cached values. Data links, macros and advanced effects are not executed.
Zero-size shape axes use a minimal editing frame; original public dimensions remain preserved in the source package.
